title: State of the Amazon Seller 2025 - Jungle Scout
summary: Vendor survey summary of Amazon sellers: rising shipping, goods and advertising costs are the top concern, and sourcing is shifting from China to the US.

assertions.quote: of businesses cite rising costs as a top challenge for selling on Amazon in 2025.

verdicts.note: Vendor survey of self-selected sellers; consistent with Amazon fee increases and ad-cost inflation.

assertions.quote: of brands, retailers, and SMBs are worried about 3P sellers on Amazon.

verdicts.note: Survey sentiment; third-party sellers do account for over half of Amazon unit sales.

assertions.quote: fewer businesses are sourcing from China, while sourcing from the U.S. has nearly doubled.

verdicts.note: Vendor survey; tariff pressure makes it plausible but the base of US sourcing is small.

assertions.quote: say growing advertising expenses are a concern

verdicts.note: Amazon's advertising revenue has grown faster than its marketplace and organic placement has shrunk.
